verdict.rationale: Apify publishes an OpenAPI spec (probe-2) and a v2 REST API with official JS and Python clients. These cover the core platform objects: running Actors and waiting for results, tasks with saved inputs, webhooks, dataset retrieval and export, log streaming, and input validation. A CLI also controls the platform from scripts. However, nothing in the pack states or demonstrates that every UI capability is exposed through the API, and some UI features have no API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for organization/permission management, scheduling, monitoring/alerts and Store publishing, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
